suppress.notes: HDPI-8150: false positive. CVE-2020-29582 concerns kotlin-stdlib temp-file permissions; kotlin-stdlib is a transitive dependency only and PCS creates no temp files through it. Re-review by the until date.
CPE mismatch: PCS uses only the Java OTel client; these CVEs target the JS/Go clients which are absent from this codebase

HDPI-9102: false positive (CPE mismatch). CVE-2026-33117 affects only com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys < 4.10.6, which PCS does not depend on. NVD records it against the whole "azure_sdk_for_java" product, before 4.10.6, so dependency-check flags every com.azure jar whose own version number is below 4.10.6. https://github.com/advisories/ghsa-97jf-46m3-8953 Re-review by the until date.

HDPI-9102: false positive (already patched). CVE-2023-36415 was fixed in azure-identity 1.10.2, and CVE-2024-35255 in azure-identity 1.12.2 / msal4j 1.15.1. PCS has azure-identity 1.18.4 and msal4j 1.23.1. NVD's CPE version ranges for these products do not line up with the Java artifact versions. Re-review by the until date.

HDPI-8150: false positive (CPE mismatch). GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp scopes CVE-2026-53914 to org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin < 2.4.20 (fixed in 2.4.20); NVD's kotlin CPE makes dependency-check flag kotlin-stdlib 1.9.25 as well. The risk vector (build-cache deserialization) is irrelevant to PCS's runtime — PCS ships kotlin-stdlib as a transitive runtime jar but does not run the Kotlin compiler or consume Kotlin build-cache metadata in production, and does not apply the Kotlin Gradle plugin. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp Re-review by the until date.
